purpose: Teach: 栄誉/誤字/身辺/原資/無形/物欲/申し込む/差し出す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文発表は研究者の栄誉だ
lines.en: Ren — publishing a paper is an honour in research.
lines.style: Measured and direct, like he's imparting something important. Steady eye contact. Weight on the word 'honour.' Warm but not soft — the tone of someone who has seen careers built on moments like this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の誤字脱字を再点検します
lines.en: Yes. I'll go through the paper again for any typos or missing content.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Slightly quicker than the mentor — earnest and focused. No hesitation. The tone of someone who takes the weight of the advice seriously and is already acting on it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究で身辺整理を欠かすな
lines.en: Ren — don't neglect the details of your own work when you're doing research.
lines.style: Calm but pointed. Not harsh, but firm. A light pause before 'the details' — making sure he's listening. The kind of warning that comes from having seen carelessness derail good work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の原資を理解しております
lines.en: Yes. I understand where the research funding comes from.
lines.style: Quiet and steady. A slight note of humility — he's acknowledging something beyond just the literal meaning. Respectful tone, not defensive. The sound of someone who has understood the lesson.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、無形の研究成果も評価される
lines.en: Ren — intangible research outcomes are valued too.
lines.style: Reflective pause before speaking. Slower pace, like he's sharing something personal. Gentle but substantial. The tone of a mentor correcting a misconception with warmth, not criticism.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。物欲ではなく真理を求めて研究します
lines.en: Yes. I'll pursue the truth, not material gain, in my research.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slower, more thoughtful than before. The word 'truth' lands with quiet sincerity. Not performed — just honest. A moment of understanding something larger than himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究助成を申し込む際は慎重に
lines.en: Ren — be careful when you apply for research grants.
lines.style: Direct and measured. A slight narrowing of focus — this matters. Not alarmist, but the kind of steady warning from someone who has seen what careless applications cost. Practical concern underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で論文を差し出す勇気を持ちます
lines.en: Yes. I'll have the courage to present my paper at the conference.
lines.style: Firmer than before, with quiet determination. A note of resolve beneath the respect. The words 'courage' and 'conference' land with a slight emphasis — he's not just agreeing, he's committing. A subtle shift to his own conviction.
